new.typeHeading: What do you want to apply for?

typeHelp.STUDENT_LEAVE: Leave: when the student cannot come to school because of illness or a family reason
typeHelp.FEE_WAIVER: Fee waiver: ask the school to reduce or waive some fees
typeHelp.TESTIMONIAL: Testimonial: a letter from the school about the student
typeHelp.TRANSFER_CERTIFICATE: Transfer certificate: when the student is leaving the school
typeHelp.ID_CARD_REPRINT: ID card: a new card after it is lost or damaged
typeHelp.GENERAL: Other: any other letter to the school

help.type: What the application is for. Only the six student types appear here: leave, fee waiver, testimonial, transfer certificate, ID card and general.
help.addressee: General applications only: class teacher, headmaster or office. A named staff member cannot be picked.
help.reasonKind: Student leave: sick, family or other.
help.startDate: First day of leave. Past dates are allowed.
help.endDate: Last day of leave. Same as or after the start date.
help.details: Explain the reason for the leave, 3 to 1000 characters.
help.waiverValue: Percent: 1 to 100. Amount: more than zero, at most 2 decimals.
help.feeTypes: Which fees the waiver is for. Leave empty for all fees.
help.waiverStart: When the waiver should start. Can be left empty.
help.waiverEnd: When the waiver should end. Same as or after the start.
help.purpose: What the testimonial is for, such as college admission; 3 to 300 characters.
help.leavingDate: The day the student leaves the school.
help.destination: Name or place of the new school, up to 200 characters.
help.reason: Reason for a fee waiver, transfer certificate or ID card, 3 to 1000 characters.
help.subjectLine: One-line subject of a general application, 3 to 200 characters.
help.body: The main text of a general application, 3 to 5000 characters.
help.attachments: Up to 3 files, 5 MB each. PDF, JPG or PNG.
